name_de: Cube Stereo Hybrid ONE22 SLX 800 FE
name_en: Cube Stereo Hybrid ONE22 SLX 800 FE
description_de: Das Cube Stereo Hybrid ONE22 SLX 800 FE ist ein vollgefedertes E-Mountainbike von Cube. Der Antrieb (Bosch Performance Line CX) mit bis zu 120 Nm Drehmoment wird von einem 800-Wh-Akku gespeist. Federung: Fox 36 Float AWL RAIL 2.0, Tapered, 15x110mm, E-Bike Optimized, 120mm · Dämpfer Fox Float Rhythm RC, 185x52,5mm, Open/Firm Mode, Trunnion Mount. Schaltung: Shimano XT RD-M8200-SGS, ShadowPlus, 12-Speed. Bremsen: Shimano XT BR-M8220, Hydr. Disc Brake (203/203). Rahmen: Aluminium Superlite. Erhältlich in den Größen S, M, L, XL.
description_en: The Cube Stereo Hybrid ONE22 SLX 800 FE is a full-suspension electric mountain bike from Cube. The drive (Bosch Performance Line CX) with up to 120 Nm of torque is powered by an 800 Wh battery. Suspension: Fox 36 Float AWL RAIL 2.0, Tapered, 15x110mm, E-Bike Optimized, 120mm · Dämpfer Fox Float Rhythm RC, 185x52,5mm, Open/Firm Mode, Trunnion Mount. Drivetrain: Shimano XT RD-M8200-SGS, ShadowPlus, 12-Speed. Brakes: Shimano XT BR-M8220, Hydr. Disc Brake (203/203). Frame: Aluminium Superlite. Available in sizes S, M, L, XL.
